_note: Live-video stream catalog: cue windows into remote archive.org files (item + file + in/out seconds) with genre-affinity tags. THIS FILE IS SOURCE (committed); the local found/video/*.mp4 clips are a regenerable cache + the slow-network / archive.org-blocked FALLBACK tier (fetch-found-video.sh / cut-lib-clips.sh). `name` is the stable clip id (= GENRE_CLIPS key = local cache basename); stream URL = https://archive.org/download/<item>/<encodeURI(file)> played over a #t=in cue window. Entries with item:null (the found/video/lib reels) are LOCAL-ONLY: archive.org slug unrecovered (see SOURCES.md), they play from the local cache when present, else are skipped. video-layer.js reads this.
